<?php
class BaseA165 {}
class BaseB165 {}
trait Body165 {
    public static function m(parent $value): string {
        echo 'body:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';';
        return 'ok';
    }
    public const array Y = [self::alias(...)];
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
trait Layer165 { use Body165; }
set_error_handler(static function () { return true; });
class First165 extends BaseA165 {
    use Layer165 { m as alias; }
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
$old = First165::Y[0];
$old = clone $old;
class Later165 extends BaseB165 {
    use Layer165 { m as alias; }
    public static array $x = self::Y;
}
$later = Later165::Y[0];
try { echo 'later-a:', $later(new BaseA165), ';'; }
catch (Throwable $e) { echo 'later-a-error:', $e->getMessage(), ';'; }
try { echo 'later-b:', $later(new BaseB165), ';'; }
catch (Throwable $e) { echo 'later-b-error:', $e->getMessage(), ';'; }
try { echo 'direct-b:', Later165::alias(new BaseB165), ';'; }
catch (Throwable $e) { echo 'direct-b-error:', $e->getMessage(), ';'; }

<?php
class BaseA165Failure {}
class BaseB165Failure {}
trait T {
    public static function m(parent $v) {
        static $n = 0;
        echo "ALIAS:", self::class, ":", static::class, ":", $v, ":", ++$n, ";";
    }
    public const Y = self::q(...);
    public static $x = self::Y;
}
trait U { use T; }
register_shutdown_function(static function () {
    echo "SHUT;";
    class E extends BaseB165Failure {
        use U;
        public static function m() { echo "FRESH;"; }
    }
    $f = E::Y;
    try { echo "A:", $f(new BaseA165Failure), ";"; }
    catch (Throwable $e) { echo "AERR:", $e->getMessage(), ";"; }
    try { echo "B:", $f(new BaseB165Failure), ";"; }
    catch (Throwable $e) { echo "BERR:", $e->getMessage(), ";"; }
    $g = clone $f;
    try { echo "CLONE:", $g(new BaseA165Failure), ";"; }
    catch (Throwable $e) { echo "CLONEERR:", $e->getMessage(), ";"; }
    E::m();
});
echo "PRE;";
class C extends BaseA165Failure {
    use U { m as q; }
    public static $x = 0;
}
echo "POST;";
